title: Can I use ai to make maps for this puzzle game? If yes, how
author: jazzuoDOTcom
selftext:
Game itself

https://extreme-bricks-3d.replit.app/

I don't like making levels so much so I made it so players can make their own submit and i would add good once to the game. But not so many people like making maps either. So could I use ai to make maps if yes how?

comments.author: Every-Prize4720
comments.body: broh. so you want to be glorified middleman

comments.author: Internal-Capital7471
comments.body: Understand what makes your levels fun and how they work, explain to ai how to build them, try it, rinse repeat until success. What Ai can not do is "make game fun plz"

replies.author: jazzuoDOTcom
replies.body: Ok but how? Computer use, brawser use? What tool and how should I use.?I basically do only chat with bot or agent on replit. Thank for reply

replies.author: Internal-Capital7471
replies.body: If you can't figure these other simple things out, you're not ready to be undertaking these tasks

replies.author: Internal-Capital7471
replies.body: I'm not going to tutor you. But if you can at least chat to an ai agent, you can ask it these questions and ask it to teach you how to do everything you're asking, including what tool or browser or w/e

replies.author: jazzuoDOTcom
replies.body: I feel question what can ia do for me is still better to ask humans because in this field ai is never up to date. It's model get shiped people use it then use cases appear. It all happens after shipping so never part of learning material

replies.author: Internal-Capital7471
replies.body: That's highly incorrect. A textbook doesn't stop being useful because there is newer information. Besides, ai can query modern information easily.
